purpose.en: Close one milestone at engineering handoff; the next dependency-satisfied milestone starts only under an explicit finite programme assignment.
purpose.zh: 在工程交付处闭环一个里程碑；下一个依赖已满足的里程碑仅在显式有限程序安排下启动。

entry.en: Implementation, review and non-live checks are complete
entry.zh: 实现、审阅与非真实验证完成

steps.zh: 列明仅真实环境待证项

exit.en: Reviewed buildable source and concise completion evidence are handed over. Continuing to a dependency-satisfied successor requires an explicit finite programme assignment.
exit.zh: 交付审阅过的可构建源码和简洁完成证据；继续到依赖已满足的后续里程碑需要显式有限程序安排。

failure.en: Incomplete code returns to implementation; missing live evidence stays separate; the next milestone remains inactive without an explicit finite programme assignment.
failure.zh: 代码缺口返回开发；真实环境待证项单独列出；没有显式有限程序安排时，下一个里程碑保持不启动。

boundary.en: Do not initiate real conversations, Computer Use or per-worker installations. Only an explicit finite programme assignment may start the next dependency-satisfied milestone after the current milestone has been reviewed and its delivery recorded.
boundary.zh: 不得自行启动真实对话、Computer Use 或各自安装客户端。只有在当前里程碑已通过评审且交付结果已记录后，显式有限程序安排才允许启动下一个依赖已满足的里程碑。
